params.name: Refund window
params.tooltip: How long after building something bulldozing it still refunds the full cost.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip: Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Full Refund writes how long its game script took to track your builds and bulldozing to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
